newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Telebrasilia started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Telebrasilia started as buy.

text.p: -- Fator Securities said in a report it has initiated coverage of Brazilian regional telecom company Telebrasilia with a buy rating.

-- Telebrasilia, which operates in the Federal District and some municipalities of the states of Goias, Tocantins, Minas Gerais and Bahia, has the highest digitalization level among its peers and the best ratio of employees per 1,000 terminals in service, it said.
-- In addition, it said the company's stock, despite its low liquidity, has a potential appreciation of 30.2 percent based on a discounted cash flow analysis at 12 percent.
-- Telebrasilia common stock was trading at 435.01 reais, up 2.35 percent.
